items.why: Meta climbed after Zuckerberg introduced the Muse Wonder AI model as its new frontier model, adding to momentum from last month's Muse AI assistant app rollout.
AMD fell with a broad chip selloff. The Philadelphia semiconductor index hit a three-week low on AI spending worries and new memory-chip competition from China's CXMT.
Crude rallied after weekend strikes on Riyadh's international airport unsettled the supply outlook, with Brent trading near $107.
Nvidia slid alongside the sector as investors questioned the pace of AI data-center spending ahead of ASML and TSMC earnings this week.

market_note: Treasury cash trading is closed for the federal holiday, so the 10-year yield is frozen at Friday's 5.24% close.
summary: Stocks are mixed on Columbus Day: the Dow is edging higher on rising oil prices while chip weakness is dragging the Nasdaq lower.
